notes.title: Dart Racer update 2.6.0: Revamped Dart progression!
notes.notes:
[p]This long in the works revamps Dart progression! [/p][p][/p][p]Completing races now rewards currency that you can spend to unlock and upgrade Dart parts. This is another step towards Galaxy Cup! 
[/p][p]That update took a while to develop... Future ones will comes faster, the plan is for 2-3 updates per month. Next up are new tracks! [/p][p][/p][p]2.6.0 Changes:[/p][p]- added currency rewards for completing races[/p][p]- rebalanced dart parts[/p][p]- tweaked dart handling[/p][p]- ai dart tweaks[/p][p]- adjusted sky track f[/p][p]- polished sky map environment[/p][p]- various polish and bug fixes[/p][p][/p][p]Happy racing playtesters![/p]

notes.title: Demo update 2.2.1!
notes.notes:
The demo was updated to version 2.2.1!

Changes:
- Balance pass on dart responsiveness
- Improved flow of the Cloud City track
- Fixed AI darts getting sometimes stuck in Cloud City
- It is now easier to unstick dart from the curved walls
- Other minor tweaks


More to come!

notes.title: Major update 2.2.0 just in time for VR Fest!
notes.notes:
Major update version 2.2.0!

Changes:
- New environment: Cloud City
- New endurance race in Cloud City
- Reworked Dart steering, added drifting for tight corners
- Added race intro cinematics
- Added and updated boost effects
- Punch to boost/drift
- Many QoL changes

More to come!

notes.title: Demo update 2.1.0!
notes.notes:
The demo was updated to version 2.1.0!

Changes:
- Added split and lap times differences, easy way to see if you did better!
- Darts are no longer bound by gravity! Added side paths in few tracks as a test. Additionally driving should feel smoooooth
- Updated Dart dashboard, now is prettier!
- Laser/pointer should match expected direction, less confusing maybe?
- Other tweaks and fixes

[previewyoutube=VgWjz4EIxdU;full][/previewyoutube]

More to come!
